description: Changes the fields you send on a draft. Fails once the owner has signed.

basis.description: `use`: already selling under the mark. `itu`: planning to, with a real intent.

classes.description: The classes to file in, 1 to 10.

wording.description: Goods and services wording, with every `[blank]` filled in.

description.description: What's sold under the mark, in the person's words.

first_use.description: With `use`: first used anywhere, as `YYYY-MM` or `YYYY-MM-DD`.

first_use_in_commerce.description: With `use`: first sold across state lines, as `YYYY-MM` or `YYYY-MM-DD`.

kind.description: What the mark is. A logo is filed as words first.

mark.description: The name, slogan or wording to protect, exactly as the person wants it.

owner.description: Who will own the mark. On an update, only the fields you send change.

email.description: Where we reach the owner about this application.

state_of_organization.description: Company owners: the state it was formed in.

street.description: Street address where the owner lives or is based. Not a PO box.

token.description: The secret for this one, from its create response or status link.

name: update_application
title: Update application
